sourceMappingDecisions: Twenty source rows map to eighteen physical new articles and two baseline reuses, 向かう and 蒸す.
向う/むかう is the same1604800 identity as向かう. Add explicit bounded spelling recognition; preserve its N4 and all prior teaching. Distinguish1277140向う/むこう rather than pooling homographs.
Source剥く maps to usually-kanaむく, with剥く and剝く explicitly recognized. Do not reuse homophonous向く.
診る is a separate medical-examination identity, not unrestricted見る. The public見る wrapper supports it only in its expressly marked medical sense.
蒸す receives sourcedjlpt2; all stable metadata, old body and exclusions remain. No baseline-policy weakening.
Only蒸し暑い/蒸 is a new source-primary reciprocal N2 pair. Retain all written characters in metadata without inventing missing kanji cards; recheck existing蒸す/蒸.
inspectionStageAdvance.stage: Actual author reads completed before card drafting; not independent certification.
sourceAccessLimits: All15 complete family chunks, all20 older-body chunks and the complete蒸 chunk were actually read through their recorded ends;知る was separately read in full.
All290 navigation labels and33 complete component records were actually read. Unselected prepared families and labels are not claimed as complete-body inspection.

All20 frozen public wrappers were read. Nineteen contain applicable Digital Daijisen bodies;向う contains none and is not positive public corroboration. The pinned complete1604800 family independently supports the reuse.
Separate metricミリ from the Malaysian city, medical診る from nonmedical見る senses,剥く/むく from剥く/すく, and modern ordinary evidence from classical quotations.

The pinned名前 family records general name and given-name senses, not an explicit separate surname sense. General name can refer to a surname in context; do not misdescribe the actual entry or its old body.
The田中 lookup miss is a JMdict navigation boundary, not proof against the proper name. Its complete surname card was separately read, not mistaken for a generic surname noun.
The pre-existing行く lone CR is preserved by CRLF-only normalization; exact parent authentication was not bypassed and the old card was not incidentally edited.
These reads support direct pairwise judgments, not a thematic clique, POS/transitivity amnesty, exhaustive semantic uniqueness, native-speaker certification or measured model-bias reduction.

見慣れる compares with actual accustomed/familiar/knowing uses; 見つける's added visual-familiarity sense is now taught. 親しい sense2 and知る familiarity are full-family evidence, not unrestricted interpersonal intimacy or every kind of knowing.
醜い includes appearance and disgraceful conduct; compareみっともない,下品,恥ずかしい,汚い and悪い's full-family ugly sense rather than claiming every bad thing is ugly.
実る physical and figurative fruition directly compare with生る and harvest/success/realized-result labels. 結果's fruit-bearing sense is in its complete family, not the older body's selected teaching.

身分's standing, identity/origin and circumstances/means require each declared rank/position/origin/condition comparison separately. 氏名 identity is name-based, not proof that all status is a full name. No automatic surname, profession, life or social-topic clique.
見本 compares directly with samples, specimens, examples, patterns/models and representative exemplars;代表 family2 is model/example,個体's specimen label is assessed, not every individual or artwork.

見舞う compares separately with concern/visit/inquiry/comfort and attack/impact labels; different grammatical roles do not alone resolve bare hit/strike labels. Classical casual visiting is not promoted to an ordinary modern rule.

未満 excludes the numerical boundary. 以下's inclusive numeric use remains distinguished, but its ordinary nonnumeric below/inferior use is not erased. 下 is a direct below/under label;不足 is not treated as a general synonym for any arbitrary threshold.

名字/姓 is direct;名 and名前 are broader names. Do not turn氏/し respectful suffix,氏名 full name or the proper name田中 into an unrestricted generic surname equivalent. The pinned名前 family has no explicit third surname sense.
Metricミリ is not made a measurement-unit clique withセンチ,キロ,グラム orメートル; powers and dimensions remain distinct.

診る is medical. Direct medical/diagnostic/testing and generic English examination/check/look labels are adjudicated separately;試験 and検討 do not thereby become Japanese medical synonyms. Ordinary見る medical sense supports the spelling contrast; bare English labels can remain ambiguous.

民間's private/nonofficial/civilian and ordinary-society/folk uses are considered against社会,世間,公衆,公共 and一般. English public is not automatically governmental; narrower私立/個人/私鉄 identities are not automatically sector synonyms.
民謡 compares directly with broad歌/歌謡; folk-related popular song is not every chart hit, nor every music genre a quiz pair.

向かう already has inbound向く/対する guards; added向ける,進む and行く are assessed directly for orientation and actual movement, not inferred through向く. Movement/facing can overlap even though arrival and transitivity differ.
むく compares withはがす covering/bark peeling,削る paring, and broader取る/除く removal. Do not invent a rigid fruit-versus-label boundary or use the homophone向く as a synonym.
無限's noun eternity supports永久/永遠;無数 is directly compared on its own card. 無数 can be vast finite abundance without being finite-only;各many-word comparison concerns quantity, not all nouns for a crowd.

無地's plain/patternless surface and unprinted-paper uses are compared with actual plain/simple/unshowy/ordinary/blank labels; no claim that it requires whiteness or geographic原/野/平野, and no transitive plain-word clique among the older cards.

蒸し暑い is assessed directly against蒸す and actual heat/damp/humidity labels, not inherited automatically from蒸す's guards. 湿度 remains a measure rather than automatically sultry. 矛盾 is inconsistency/incompatibility. Differences/discrepancies and conflicting/opposed assertions are assessed directly, not every quarrel, mistake, error or contrary opinion. 一致 is a contrast, not a synonym.
